newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe executes five convicted murderers.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe executes five convicted murderers.

text.p: Zimbabwe hanged five convicted murderers on Friday, bringing to seven the number of executions it has carried out in the past year.
Sheriff Beatrice Donzwa said in a statement the five -- Bongani Serengwani Sithole, Smile Nkomo, Charles Gijima Munyengwi, Emmanuel Ncube and Peter Kuyeri -- were hanged at dawn.
President Robert Mugabe's government has so far resisted pressure from local and international human rights groups to abolish the death sentence in the southern African nation.
